x_failures: Cites Paulet p.42 for Lingzhi featuring 'in early Daoist texts as mushrooms of immortality', but the page only says mushroom use is established 'from time immemorial in China'. It also says Galen poured yeast water on 'black poplars', when the page gives black poplar for the Tarentine and white poplar for Galen.
reason: Y's claims about Hippocrates, Menander, Pliny, Claudius, Cesalpino and Micheli are all supported by the cited pages, and it traces the earliest mentions more fully. X attaches an unsupported Daoist/Lingzhi claim to Paulet and mixes up the poplar details on the Briganti page.
